title: Critique: AST explains only the belief in consciousness

statements.text: AST explains why people believe they are conscious, or their introspective certainty, but not consciousness itself if consciousness means qualia. Explaining judgments about consciousness does not solve or dissolve the problem of consciousness.

sources.quote: maybe it explains our beliefs about consciousness, or our introspective certainty that we have it
On my view, consciousness is real, and explaining our judgments about consciousness does not suffice to solve or dissolve the problem of consciousness.
